title_zh: AI 芯片带动基板扩产，FC-BGA 制造设备交期拉长至 30 个月
content_zh:
据韩国《电子新闻》11 月 25 日报道，AI 芯片需求激增引发全球封装基板厂集中扩产，导致倒装芯片球栅阵列（FC-BGA）基板关键加工设备的交付周期拉长。部分原本下单后约 6 个月即可交付的设备，目前需等待约 30 个月，接近平时的 5 倍。

报道指出，基板接合、切割和金属化等核心设备高度依赖日本产精密电机与伺服控制器等零部件，而日本上游零件交期也已从现货延长至约半年。部分大型基板厂商已开始预付定金或提前提交采购意向书抢占产能，主要涉及日本揖斐电、新光电气、中国台湾欣兴电子以及韩国三星电机、LG 伊诺特等厂商。
title_en: FC-BGA Equipment Lead Times Stretch to 30 Months Amid AI Chip Boom
content_en:
A global expansion among substrate manufacturers driven by surging demand for AI chips has triggered severe supply shortages for critical manufacturing machinery. Lead times for Flip Chip Ball Grid Array (FC-BGA) substrate processing equipment have reportedly stretched from a normal six months to nearly 30 months—a roughly fivefold increase.

The bottleneck stems primarily from upstream Japanese component suppliers. Essential parts for core substrate processes—such as bonding, dicing, and metallization—rely heavily on Japanese precision motors and servo controllers, which now face lead times of around six months for spot orders.

To secure limited production capacity, major global substrate suppliers are making advance down payments and submitting early purchase commitments. Affected companies include Japan's Ibiden and Shinko Electric, Taiwan's Unimicron, and South Korea's Samsung Electro-Mechanics and LG Innotek.

title_zh: 💡 众擎 CEO 赵同阳：人形机器人量产后要过「三道关」
content_zh:
在 11 月 25 日的众擎机器人全球开发者大会上，创始人兼 CEO 赵同阳谈到，人形机器人从整机量产走向商业应用，需要解决三类工程问题。机器本体要经得起长期使用，保证可靠性和生产一致性。负责决策和动作控制的系统得围绕客户的实际任务协作，机器人也要能从实际工作中积累经验、持续改进。

他以众擎的训练方式为例，介绍了如何把模仿学习和强化学习结合起来训练复杂运动技能。众擎自行采集专用训练数据，后续还计划扩展多模态感知和语言理解能力。

据新浪科技现场报道，赵同阳希望机器人先进入影响人员健康和安全的作业场景。他认为行业需求分散，一家公司难以逐个覆盖，建议开发者先选定一个行业和客户，做透具体场景。

他回忆，最初创业时想打造「机器人界的苹果」，现在更希望不同领域的开发者和产业伙伴能做出自己的机器人。他也在现场提到，公司举办了面向开发者的开源赛事。
title_en: Engine AI CEO Outlines Key Engineering Hurdles for Humanoid Robot Commercialization
content_en:
At the Engine AI Global Developer Conference, founder and CEO Zhao Tongyang outlined three critical engineering hurdles humanoid robots must clear to transition from mass production to real-world commercial application: ensuring long-term hardware reliability and manufacturing consistency, developing decision and control systems tailored to customer tasks, and enabling robots to continuously learn from operational experience.

Zhao detailed Engine AI’s technical approach, which combines imitation learning with reinforcement learning to train complex physical movement. The company utilizes proprietary datasets to train its models and plans to expand into multimodal perception and natural language understanding.

Recommending that humanoid robots first target hazardous environments to protect human safety, Zhao emphasized that industrial demand is highly fragmented. Rather than attempting to cover all sectors, he advised developers to focus deeply on specific vertical use cases. Shifting away from his initial vision of creating the "Apple of robotics," Zhao expressed a renewed ambition to empower developers and industry partners to build their own domain-specific robotic solutions.

title_zh: Genspark 推出 VoicePad 语音键盘
content_zh:
Genspark 的 SecondBrain VoicePad 于 11 月 24 日在 Kickstarter 开启众筹。这台带双麦克风的桌面控制器可为 Windows 和 macOS 电脑提供语音输入与快捷键。Genspark 向媒体提供的众筹定价预期从 119 美元起，首批计划明年 1 月发货。

众筹页面显示，设备可通过蓝牙或 USB-C 连接电脑。四个小按键可以在 Speakly 应用里自定义，比如打开 ChatGPT 或 Claude、启动会议记录，或执行复制粘贴。宽键固定用来按住说话，还能把 50 多种语言的口述转成英文，在当前应用里输入。

VoicePad 采用 CNC 加工的铝合金机身，重约 85 克，标称续航约 20 小时。脱离电脑时，仍可用它录下会议或语音备忘，并用内置扬声器回放。
title_en: Genspark Launches VoicePad: A Voice-Controlled Desktop Keypad for AI Workflows
content_en:
Genspark has launched a crowdfunding campaign on Kickstarter for the SecondBrain VoicePad, a dual-microphone desktop controller designed to bring voice input and customizable macro shortcuts to Windows and macOS. Early bird pricing starts at $119, with initial shipments scheduled for January.

Constructed from CNC-machined aluminum, the 85-gram device connects via Bluetooth or USB-C and features a 20-hour battery life. Even when disconnected from a computer, the VoicePad can record meetings or voice memos and play them back using its built-in speaker.

The hardware includes four customizable hotkeys—managed through the companion Speakly app—to launch AI services like ChatGPT and Claude, initiate meeting notes, or execute standard shortcuts. A dedicated push-to-talk key enables real-time dictation, capable of translating spoken audio from over 50 languages into written English directly into active applications.

title_zh: 26.99 万元起，宝马首款国产新世代车型 iX3 上市并开始交付
content_zh: 11 月 25 日，宝马新世代 iX3 在中国内地上市并启动交付。这是新世代纯电平台的首款国产车型，由华晨宝马在沈阳生产。国产版轴距为 3005mm，比海外标轴版长 108mm，全系配备 800V 高压平台及第六代 eDrive 电驱系统。三个版本的上市价格与预订一致，按全国统一价销售。
title_en: BMW Launches Domestically Built Next-Gen iX3 EV in China, Starting at RMB 269,900
content_en:
BMW has officially launched and commenced deliveries of its next-generation iX3 electric vehicle in mainland China. Manufactured by BMW Brilliance in Shenyang, the SUV is the first domestically produced model built on BMW's new dedicated EV platform.

Tailored for the Chinese market, the domestic iX3 features an extended 3,005 mm wheelbase—108 mm longer than the global standard version. The entire lineup comes standard with an 800V high-voltage architecture and BMW's sixth-generation eDrive propulsion system, with nationwide pricing starting at RMB 269,900.

title_zh: 腾讯公布混元 Hy4 flash 本地实测，64 GB 内存的 Mac mini 也能跑
content_zh:
腾讯混元公布了 Hy4 flash 在多款个人设备上的部署结果。原模型总参数量为 2240 亿，原始权重约占 410 GiB。AngelSlim 提供了五种 GGUF 量化版本，其中体积最小的 IQ2-AH 约占 126 GiB。

在 64 GB 内存的 M4 Pro Mac mini 上，腾讯使用 Strata 按需从 SSD 读取部分权重。官方模型卡显示，这一配置在 8K 上下文测试中每秒生成约 17 个 token。128 GB 内存的 M5 Max Mac 使用 Q3_K 版本，在 32K 上下文测试中每秒生成约 47 个 token。
title_en: Tencent Demonstrates 224B Hunyuan Hy4 Flash AI Running Locally on Mac mini
content_en:
Tencent Hunyuan has revealed local deployment test results for its Hy4 Flash AI model on personal devices. Originally boasting 224 billion parameters requiring approximately 410 GiB of raw weight storage, the model has been optimized using AngelSlim into five quantized GGUF versions, with the smallest (IQ2-AH) occupying roughly 126 GiB.

Demonstrating local execution on consumer hardware, Tencent used the Strata framework to dynamically stream weights from SSD storage. On a Mac mini equipped with an M4 Pro chip and 64 GB of RAM, the model achieved generation speeds of about 17 tokens per second in an 8K context test. A higher-tier configuration featuring an M5 Max Mac with 128 GB of RAM running the Q3_K version generated around 47 tokens per second within a 32K context window.

title_zh: Sand.ai 推出 MAGI-2，一次可生成 30 秒有声视频
content_zh:
Sand.ai 发布视频生成模型 MAGI-2，单次可生成最长 30 秒的 1080p 视频，帧率为 25 fps。对白、环境音和画面由同一模型同步生成。一次请求最多可用 10 张图片、5 段视频和 5 段音频作为参考，也可以按时间指定切镜，或对已有视频做局部修改。

APPSO 在 LibTV 实测了多语言口播编辑。模型将同一段产品口播分别改成法语和意大利语，配合新对白调整人物口型，并基本保留了原镜头和构图。MAGI-2 正式版共有 4800 亿参数，单次推理激活约 280 亿参数，Sand.ai 计划后续公开正式版权重。
title_en: Sand.ai Introduces MAGI-2: AI Model Generating 30-Second Synchronized Audio-Visual Videos
content_en:
Sand.ai has released MAGI-2, a video generation model capable of producing up to 30 seconds of 1080p video at 25 fps in a single inference run. Unlike traditional video models, MAGI-2 natively synchronizes visuals, dialogue, and ambient audio within a unified framework.

The model offers versatile editing capabilities, allowing inputs of up to 10 images, 5 video clips, and 5 audio files as reference materials. Users can schedule shot cuts by timestamp or make localized edits to existing footage, such as automatically adjusting lip movements to fit multilingual voiceovers while preserving the original frame composition.

MAGI-2 boasts 480 billion total parameters, with roughly 28 billion activated per inference. Sand.ai plans to open-source the official model weights in an upcoming update.
